scope: Generic category cardinality, bounded peripheral workload, time-management and broader-review requirements. No extraction recipe, branch counts, coordinates, source courses or previous outputs supplied.
adjudication_limit: No new label inheritance rule or retrospective GT relabeling. Ambiguous anatomy remains a separate review outcome.
comparison_limit: Outcome-informed prompt refinement on the same public development case; not held-out capability estimation.
launch_config_policy: Local configs retain required host routing/auth setup, not credential contents; configs are not committed.
